findings.title: TLS 1.0 detected — deprecated protocol
findings.description: TLS 1.0 is deprecated (RFC 8996) and is vulnerable to BEAST, POODLE, and related attacks. PCI DSS and NIST require disabling TLS 1.0.
findings.impact: Sessions may be vulnerable to protocol downgrade attacks and known exploits.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to TLS 1.2 or preferably TLS 1.3. Disable TLS 1.0 on all mail servers.

findings.title: Weak cipher suite detected: TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA
findings.description: The cipher suite "TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA" provides inadequate security. This cipher is susceptible to cryptographic attacks and should not be used in production email infrastructure.
findings.impact: Encrypted communications may be decryptable by a capable attacker.

findings.title: No Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS)
findings.description: The observed key exchange does not provide Perfect Forward Secrecy. If the server's private key is compromised in the future, all past session recordings can be decrypted.
findings.impact: Past and future sessions become decryptable if the server private key is compromised.
findings.recommendation: Configure ECDHE or DHE key exchange. Prefer TLS 1.3 which mandates ephemeral key exchange.

findings.title: Static RSA key exchange in use
findings.description: RSA key exchange does not provide forward secrecy. Session keys are derived from the server's long-term private key.
findings.impact: Historical session traffic becomes decryptable if server private key is later compromised.
findings.recommendation: Switch to ECDHE key exchange with a modern named group (X25519 or secp256r1).

findings.title: STARTTLS not offered
findings.description: The SMTP server does not advertise STARTTLS capability, allowing clients to connect without TLS encryption.
findings.impact: Unencrypted email transmission exposed to network interception.
findings.recommendation: Enable STARTTLS on the mail server. For higher security, require STARTTLS (smtpd_tls_security_level = encrypt).

findings.title: Certificate is expired
findings.description: The server certificate expired on 2026-09-21. Clients may reject the certificate or display warnings, degrading email delivery reliability.
findings.impact: Certificate expiration may cause TLS handshake failures and email delivery disruption.
findings.recommendation: Renew the server certificate immediately and establish a certificate rotation schedule.

findings.title: Weak public key: RSA 1024-bit
findings.description: The certificate uses a 1024-bit RSA key. This key size is considered insufficient by current cryptographic standards.
findings.impact: Weak keys can be factored by dedicated attackers, compromising server identity verification.
findings.recommendation: Replace with RSA-2048 minimum (RSA-3072 recommended) or ECDSA P-256.
